mapper.update: CREATE TABLE ${tableName} ( IMGKEY INT IDENTITY (1,1) NOT NULL, GROUP_KEY VARCHAR(100), GROUP_CNT VARCHAR(1), STATUS VARCHAR(1) DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, RSLT VARCHAR(10), RSLTDESC VARCHAR(1000), SENDABLE VARCHAR(1) DEFAULT 'N' NOT NULL, BRAND_ID VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, IMG_PATH VARCHAR(128), IMG_ID VARCHAR(100), MEDIA_URL VARCHAR(256), REQDATE DATETIME NOT NULL, RPTDATE DATETIME, TEMPLATE_YN VARCHAR(1) NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT PK_${tableName} PRIMARY KEY (IMGKEY) )
mapper.select: SELECT TOP 100 IMGKEY AS [key], IMG_PATH AS image_path, IMG_ID AS file_id, BRAND_ID, REQDATE AS request_date, TEMPLATE_YN FROM ${tableName} WHERE STATUS = '0' AND SENDABLE = 'N' AND REQDATE < GETDATE()
SELECT TOP 100 IMGKEY AS [key] FROM ${tableName} WHERE STATUS IN ('0','9') AND REQDATE < GETDATE() - 30 / 24 / 60 / 60
